\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- Boolean Blocks}

\section{Overview}
Finite coordinate reindexing and currying preserve product measures. The Boolean Bobkov inequality therefore holds for arbitrary finite coordinate sets and for arrays of bits.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{lemma}[Currying preserves finite product laws]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.measurePreserving_finiteCurry}
\leanok
\difficulty{5}
Let $I,J,B$ be finite sets, let $B$ carry a measurable structure with measurable singletons, and let $\mu_{ij}$ be sigma-finite measures on $B$. The bijection $B^{I\times J}\to(B^J)^I$ sending $x$ to the array $i\mapsto(j\mapsto x(i,j))$ pushes $\bigotimes_{(i,j)}\mu_{ij}$ to $\bigotimes_i\bigotimes_j\mu_{ij}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Bobkov inequality for finite coordinates]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkov_inequality_finite_index}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.BoolCube,BooleanAnalysis.BooleanFunc,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkovFunctional,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkov_inequality,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.integral_uniformBool_pi_eq_expect,BooleanAnalysis.derivative,BooleanAnalysis.expect}
\difficulty{6}
Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. Let $I$ be finite and $f:\{0,1\}^I\to[0,1]$. Under the independent uniform bit law, $\overline I(\mathbb E f)\le\mathbb E\sqrt{\overline I(f)^2+\sum_{i\in I}(D_i f)^2}$, where $D_i f(x)=(f(x^{i\leftarrow0})-f(x^{i\leftarrow1}))/2$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Bobkov inequality for Boolean arrays]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkov_inequality_array}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.bobkov_inequality_finite_index,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.closedGaussianProfile,BooleanAnalysis.GaussianSpace.measurePreserving_finiteCurry}
\difficulty{5}
Let $\Phi,\varphi$ be the standard Gaussian distribution function and density, and let $\overline I(p)=\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$, with $\overline I(p)=0$ elsewhere. Let $I,J$ be finite and $f:\{0,1\}^{I\times J}\to[0,1]$. Under independent uniform bits, $\overline I(\mathbb E f)\le\mathbb E\sqrt{\overline I(f)^2+\sum_{i\in I}\sum_{j\in J}(D_{ij}f)^2}$, where $D_{ij}f(x)=(f(x^{ij\leftarrow0})-f(x^{ij\leftarrow1}))/2$.
\end{lemma}
